endorsements.name: Lun Yen
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-10919
endorsements.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of C-MORE HMI EA9 Firmware version 6.52 touch screen panels. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of passwords. When transmitting passwords, the process encrypts them in a recoverable format. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-10185.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.0, 5.9)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Lun Yen
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-10920
endorsements.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of C-MORE HMI EA9 Firmware version 6.52 touch screen panels. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the control service, which listens on TCP port 9999 by default. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing alterations to the system configuration. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10493.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.0, 9.8)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Lun Yen
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-10921
endorsements.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to issue commands on affected installations of C-MORE HMI EA9 Firmware version 6.52 touch screen panels. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the EA-HTTP.exe process. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing alterations to the system configuration. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to issue commands to the physical equipment controlled by the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10482.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.0, 9.8)
